score, even though the tokens on the desk are counted normally. An adjustment of [[*ts*]]−9[[*te*]]
followed by a bonus gives [[*ts*]]−9 + 17 = 8[[*te*]], while [[*ts*]]8 − 15 = −7[[*te*]] shows how a later
penalty can move the balance below zero.
